metadata.description: Curated real-world financial IR and information retrieval benchmark using genuine statutory SEC Form 10-K filings across AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, and NVDA.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's total consolidated net sales and product revenue breakdown in fiscal year 2023 compared to 2022?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Total net sales were $383,285 million in 2023, compared to $394,328 million in 2022. Products net sales were $298,085 million in 2023 compared to $316,199 million in 2022, while Services net sales grew to $85,200 million in 2023 from $78,129 million in 2022.
queries.annotation_rationale: Directly extracted from MD&A Consolidated Results of Operations net sales table in Apple's FY2023 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: How did Apple's gross margin percentage change between fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2023, and what factors influenced product versus services gross margin?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Gross margin was $169,148 million or 44.1% in 2023, compared to $170,782 million or 43.3% in 2022. Products gross margin was 36.5% in 2023 compared to 36.3% in 2022, and Services gross margin was 70.8% in 2023 compared to 71.7% in 2022.
queries.annotation_rationale: Gross margin percentage and driver discussion extracted from MD&A Gross Margin analysis table in Apple FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's operating cash flow and total capital return to shareholders via share repurchases and dividends in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Cash generated by operating activities was $110,543 million in 2023. Payments for repurchase of common stock were $77,550 million and payments for dividends and dividend equivalents were $15,025 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows in Item 8 Financial Statements of Apple FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What specific international trade and supply chain concentration risks does Apple identify regarding outsourced manufacturing in the Asia-Pacific region?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Substantially all of the Company's manufacturing is performed by outsourced partners located primarily in Asia, including mainland China, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam. Disruptions from geopolitical tensions, natural disasters, or trade restrictions could materially adversely affect operations.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Item 1A Risk Factors relating to global operations and manufacturing dependencies.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's total research and development expense and strategic capital expenditure in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Research and development expense was $29,915 million or 8% of total net sales in 2023, compared to $26,251 million or 7% of net sales in 2022. Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment were $10,959 million in 2023.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Item 7 Operating Expenses and Item 8 Statement of Cash Flows investing activities.

queries.research_question: What pending antitrust legal proceedings and app marketplace regulatory investigations are disclosed in Apple's Form 10-K?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: The Company is subject to legal proceedings and government investigations concerning its App Store terms, developer fees, and digital market access rules in the United States and European Union under the Digital Markets Act.
queries.annotation_rationale: Preliminary annotation from Note 10 Commitments and Contingencies; awaiting secondary legal reviewer sign-off.

queries.research_question: What was Microsoft's revenue breakdown across its three reporting segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Total revenue was $211,915 million in fiscal year 2023. Productivity and Business Processes revenue was $69,274 million, Intelligent Cloud revenue was $87,907 million, and More Personal Computing revenue was $54,734 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Segment Results of Operations in Microsoft FY2023 Form 10-K MD&A.

queries.research_question: What was Microsoft's operating income and operating margin percentage in fiscal year 2023 compared to fiscal year 2022?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Operating income was $88,523 million in fiscal year 2023, representing an operating margin of 41.8%, compared to $83,383 million or an operating margin of 42.1% in fiscal year 2022.
queries.annotation_rationale: Directly extracted from MD&A Consolidated Results of Operations table in Microsoft FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What was Microsoft's cash flow from operations, capital expenditures, and free cash flow generation in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Cash flow from operations was $87,582 million in fiscal year 2023, compared to $89,035 million in 2022. Additions to property and equipment were $28,107 million, resulting in free cash flow of $59,475 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Statements of Cash Flows and Liquidity Analysis in Microsoft FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What key cybersecurity risks and potential liability disclosures does Microsoft report regarding sophisticated nation-state cyberattacks and cloud service availability?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities in Microsoft or partner networks, including state-sponsored adversaries and novel generative AI threat vectors, can compromise proprietary customer data, disrupt mission-critical Azure cloud infrastructure, and inflict severe regulatory penalties.
queries.annotation_rationale: Item 1A Risk Factors - Operational and Cybersecurity Threat disclosures in MSFT FY2023 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: How does Microsoft describe the strategic driver behind its Azure and AI infrastructure investments in the Intelligent Cloud business?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Our Intelligent Cloud segment encompasses public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that can power modern enterprise computing. Azure is a comprehensive set of cloud services that developers and IT professionals use to build, deploy, and manage applications through our global network of datacenters.
queries.annotation_rationale: Item 1 Business Description for Intelligent Cloud and Azure capabilities in Microsoft FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What are the contractual terms and closing contingencies disclosed regarding the proposed acquisition of Activision Blizzard?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: In January 2022, Microsoft announced the planned acquisition of Activision Blizzard, Inc. for $68.7 billion. The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals from antitrust authorities.
queries.annotation_rationale: Note 3 Business Combinations in Notes to Financial Statements; awaiting final post-closing amendment verification.

queries.research_question: What was Tesla's total revenue breakdown between Automotive, Energy generation and storage, and Services and other in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Total revenues were $96,773 million in 2023. Automotive segment revenues were $82,419 million, Energy generation and storage revenues were $6,035 million, and Services and other revenues were $8,319 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Consolidated Results of Operations table in Tesla FY2023 Form 10-K Item 7.

queries.research_question: Why did Tesla's total gross profit margin decline from 25.6% in 2022 to 18.2% in 2023, and what pricing actions caused this contraction?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Total gross margin was 18.2% in 2023 compared to 25.6% in 2022. The decline in automotive gross margin was primarily due to price reductions in our vehicle offerings, higher raw material costs, freight charges, and production ramp inefficiencies.
queries.annotation_rationale: Gross margin driver commentary in Item 7 MD&A of Tesla FY2023 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: What was Tesla's net cash provided by operating activities and capital expenditure spending in fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Net cash provided by operating activities was $13,256 million in 2023. Capital expenditures were $8,898 million in 2023 compared to $7,158 million in 2022, resulting in free cash flow of $4,358 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Liquidity disclosures in Tesla FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What manufacturing ramp and supply chain bottleneck risks does Tesla disclose regarding lithium-ion battery cell production and Cybertruck volume scaling?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: We may experience delays in manufacturing ramps for new vehicle architectures such as Cybertruck, next generation platform vehicles, and our proprietary 4680 battery cells, resulting from raw material supplier constraints and complex manufacturing execution.
queries.annotation_rationale: Item 1A Risk Factors - Operational and Manufacturing Execution in Tesla FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: What were Tesla's total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities reserves at the end of fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Total cash and cash equivalents and investments were $29,094 million at December 31, 2023, consisting of $16,398 million in cash and cash equivalents and $12,696 million in short-term investments.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Consolidated Balance Sheets in Item 8 of Tesla FY2023 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: What regulatory investigations and Department of Justice subpoenas regarding Full Self-Driving claims are disclosed in Tesla's 10-K?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: The Company has received requests for information and subpoenas from government authorities, including the DOJ and SEC, concerning Autopilot and Full Self-Driving capabilities.
queries.annotation_rationale: Note 15 Contingencies in Item 8 Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements; pending full litigation counsel annotation.

queries.research_question: What was NVIDIA's total revenue in fiscal year 2024 and how much did Data Center revenue grow compared to fiscal year 2023?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Revenue was $60,922 million for fiscal year 2024, up 126% from a year ago. Data Center revenue was $47,525 million, up 217% from fiscal year 2023, driven by accelerated computing and generative AI workloads.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from MD&A Consolidated Results of Operations and Segment Revenue in NVIDIA FY2024 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: How did NVIDIA's gross margin percentage expand from 56.9% in fiscal year 2023 to 72.7% in fiscal year 2024?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Gross margin increased to 72.7% in fiscal year 2024 from 56.9% in fiscal year 2023, reflecting higher Data Center sales growth, favorable product mix, and lower inventory provisions.
queries.annotation_rationale: Directly extracted from Item 7 MD&A Gross Margin analysis in NVIDIA FY2024 10-K.

queries.research_question: What was NVIDIA's net cash provided by operating activities and free cash flow generation in fiscal year 2024?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: Net cash provided by operating activities was $28,090 million in fiscal year 2024, compared to $5,641 million in fiscal year 2023. Payments for property and equipment were $1,143 million, resulting in free cash flow of $26,947 million.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows in Item 8 of NVIDIA FY2024 10-K.

queries.research_question: What export control regulations and licensing restrictions on advanced computing chips shipped to China does NVIDIA disclose in its risk factors?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: The U.S. government announced updated export licensing requirements restricting sales of our A100, A800, H100, H800, and L40S products to China and certain other regions. Our competitive position has been harmed, and we may be effectively excluded from all or part of the China market.
queries.annotation_rationale: Extracted from Item 1A Risk Factors - Export Control and Trade Regulation Disclosures in NVIDIA FY2024 10-K.

queries.research_question: What key risks does NVIDIA outline regarding manufacturing concentration with third-party semiconductor foundry TSMC?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: We rely on third-party foundries, primarily Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC), to manufacture our semiconductor wafers and advanced CoWoS packaging. Any disruption at TSMC or geographic conflict in Taiwan could prevent us from meeting product demand.
queries.annotation_rationale: Item 1A Risk Factors - Manufacturing Concentration and Foundry Reliance in NVIDIA FY2024 10-K.

queries.research_question: What specific cloud customer revenue concentration does NVIDIA report for Customer A and Customer B in fiscal year 2024?
queries.ground_truth_excerpt: One customer represented approximately 19% of total revenue for fiscal year 2024, and a second customer represented approximately 11% of total revenue.
queries.annotation_rationale: Note 17 Segment Reporting and Geographic Information; pending final customer identity corroboration.
